target_customer: Concrete subcontractor estimators who bid structural concrete work
problem: Estimators spend long hours on manual takeoffs from plans for footings, walls, columns and slabs, which limits how many projects they can bid.
business_model: B2B SaaS for takeoff and estimating, pricing not published
product_category: AI construction takeoff and estimating for concrete

founders.name: Rishi Pankhaniya
founders.background_notes: YC page: Airbnb's first new-grad engineer in over two years. Degree type not stated.

founders.name: Sahil Goel
education: Cal Poly SLO, computer science and construction management

competitors.name: Togal.AI
competitors.what: AI auto takeoff from drawings, general commercial
competitors.traction_then: 4.8 of 5 G2 rating from 60 reviews as of July 2026 per a roundup

competitors.name: Kreo
competitors.what: Low-cost takeoff-only software starting at 35 dollars per user per month

competitors.name: Beam AI and STACK
competitors.what: Takeoff and estimating platforms with high review ratings
competitors.traction_then: Beam 4.9 of 5 from 30 reviews per one roundup

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading construction plans with computer vision and expanding elements into concrete, formwork and rebar line items is hard for a two-person team, with exports to HeavyBid, Sage and B2W adding integration work.

defensibility.rationale: General takeoff tools already exist; a narrow concrete focus and estimator workflow integrations may create some lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: General tools were adding AI takeoff features in 2026; no concrete-specific outcome yet.

market_need_then: Founders said they spent 100+ hours with structural concrete estimators before building. Roundups in 2026 show a crowded AI estimating market, indicating demand for faster takeoffs.

identity.visual_style: Dark glow, tech-forward look with a live walkthrough demo
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident, practical, aimed at estimators

branding.brand_signature: Faster takeoffs. Sharper estimates. More bids.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive short name with a clear headline, but no press or community about the brand found, and name origin unknown.

outcome_analysis: Rudus is a Spring 2026 YC company with no public outcome yet. It targets a narrow concrete subcontractor niche with claimed takeoff time cuts of 70 to 80 percent (company figures). A Hacker News commenter questioned the founders' lack of industry experience, though the CTO studied construction management. Success depends on beating general takeoff tools on concrete accuracy.
notes: Funding unverified: FundedIQ and VCBacked list a 500K pre-seed in June 2026 and a job board says seed; no investors or primary source, so no round is recorded. YC batch is Spring 2026 (P26 in some sources). Competitors are from 2026 roundups, not from founding coverage. No outcome news found.
